title: [ingest] sphinx-apidoc and sphinx-autogen --remove-old flag prevents stale-file build errors
summary: Re-running `sphinx-apidoc` or `sphinx-autogen` does NOT remove files for deleted/renamed modules by default, causing "document not in toctree" build errors. The `--remove-old` flag was added to both CLI tools to clean up stale generated files. Build systems that re-run apidoc/autogen without `--remove-old` will accumulate stale RST files.
